name: SZW - F6 Shipment Inquiry Agent
description: NEW: When an inquiry is submitted to SZW_InquiryQueue, checks FG inventory and the truck schedule in Power BI, posts an approval card to Celia/JC in Teams, and routes the confirmed order to Tonya for SYSPRO entry. Fully read-only on SYSPRO.

columns.name: RecommendedShipDate
columns.notes: Set by F6 â€” next truck on or before RequestedDate âˆ’ 3 days

columns.name: FGAvailable
columns.notes: FG units available, set by F6 from PBI query

columns.name: ConfirmedBy
columns.notes: Celia or JC who tapped Confirm on the adaptive card

columns.name: SYSPROEntered
columns.notes: Tonya marks Yes when SO/schedule is keyed in SYSPRO

steps.name: Trigger_New_Inquiry
steps.note: Captures StockCode, RequestedQty, RequestedDate, CustomerWarehouse, Priority from the new list item

steps.name: Query_FG_Availability
steps.dax: EVALUATE FILTER(SELECTCOLUMNS(SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Requirements[StockCode],Requirements[CustomerWarehouse],"FGAvail",[FG Available],"ShortQty",[Short Qty],"NextTruck1",[Next Truck 1],"NextTruck2",[Next Truck 2],"ReqShipDate",[Req Ship Date]),"StockCode",Requirements[StockCode],"CustomerWarehouse",Requirements[CustomerWarehouse],"FGAvail",[FGAvail],"ShortQty",[ShortQty],"NextTruck1",[NextTruck1],"NextTruck2",[NextTruck2],"ReqShipDate",[ReqShipDate]),Requirements[StockCode]="@{triggerBody()?['StockCode']}" && Requirements[CustomerWarehouse]="@{triggerBody()?['CustomerWarehouse']}")

steps.name: Compose_ShipBy
steps.note: Sub-Zero arrival date minus 3 calendar days transit

steps.name: Compose_TruckDate
steps.note: Next scheduled truck date on or before ShipBy â€” PBI already computes this

confirm.name: Post_Tonya_Task
confirm.message:
@{concat('**SYSPRO Entry needed** â€” Inquiry #',triggerBody()?['ID'],'

- Part: **',triggerBody()?['StockCode'],'**
- Qty: **',triggerBody()?['RequestedQty'],' units**
- Ship date: **',outputs('Compose_TruckDate'),'**
- Ship to: **',triggerBody()?['CustomerWarehouse'],'**

Please key into SYSPRO SO and mark SYSPROEntered=Yes in SZW_InquiryQueue when done.')}

confirm.name: Notify_Requestor_Confirmed
confirm.message: @{concat('Your shipment inquiry #',triggerBody()?['ID'],' for ',triggerBody()?['RequestedQty'],' units of **',triggerBody()?['StockCode'],'** has been confirmed. Recommended ship date: **',outputs('Compose_TruckDate'),'** to ',triggerBody()?['CustomerWarehouse'],'. Tonya will key into SYSPRO.')}

deny.name: Notify_Requestor_Denied
deny.subject: @{concat('[SZW] Inquiry #',triggerBody()?['ID'],' â€” Cannot Fulfill')}
deny.body:
@{concat('Unfortunately, inquiry #',triggerBody()?['ID'],' for ',triggerBody()?['RequestedQty'],' units of ',triggerBody()?['StockCode'],' cannot be fulfilled. FG available: ',first(body('Query_FG_Availability')?['results']?[0]?['tables']?[0]?['rows'])?['[FGAvail]'],' units (short by ',first(body('Query_FG_Availability')?['results']?[0]?['tables']?[0]?['rows'])?['[ShortQty]'],').
Contact Celia Nixon or Juan Zacarias to adjust the plan.')}

timeout.name: Notify_Daniel_Timeout
timeout.subject: [SZW] Inquiry #@{triggerBody()?['ID']} approval timed out after 4 hours
timeout.body: No response from Celia or JC. Please follow up.

constraints: Read-only on SYSPRO â€” Tonya manually keys SO/schedule
Standard connectors only â€” no premium plan required
Teams adaptive card approval uses Flow Bot channel; Celia and JC must have Teams access
